lines.text: The LORD gives Jeremiah a word about the Philistines before Pharaoh strikes down Gaza.
Waters rising from the north become an overflowing torrent, and the people wail at the sound of galloping stallions and rumbling chariots.
The LORD is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Cyprus, and cut off Tyre and Sidon's allies.
The people of Gaza will shave their heads in mourning, and Ashkelon will be silenced.
The sword of the LORD cannot rest, because the LORD has appointed it against Ashdod and the shore of its coastland.
